name: terminal
description: Terminal I/O cartridge. Provides a character-cell screen (80x24) and keyboard input — the microcomputer model. The LLM reads keypresses and writes characters to screen positions, operating in a closed loop like a Z80 program.

stdout.description: Write characters to screen positions. Payload: {x, y, text} or {x, y, char}.

cursor.summary: Move the cursor to position (x, y).

print.summary: Print text at cursor position and advance cursor.
